title: Reliability, Validity of the Turkish Version of the Primary Sjögren Syndrome Quality of Life (PSS-QoL) Questionnaire
brief_summary: The purpose of this study was to investigate adaptation, validity, and reliability of the Turkish version of the Primary Sjögren's Syndrome Quality of Life (PSS-QoL) Questionnaire
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosed with primary Sjögren's syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having neurological and cognitive disorders,
* Having another rheumatological diseases
study_population: Patients with primary Sjögren's syndrome between the ages of 18-90
